item.title: Sim2Real Transfer: Robust RL Control of a Furuta Pendulum
item.description: Trained a PPO control policy in a custom MuJoCo Gymnasium environment and achieved zero-shot transfer onto an ESP32 microcontroller — balancing continuously for over an hour on physical hardware with no additional tuning.
